notes.H15 cross-check on [E_4]: image (cusp x: [image] = L**2 - 1, fibres A^1, product = L**3 - L
notes.H15 cross-check on [Q], stratified by p: p in {0,-1} (2 values): qZ = 0, class 2L-1 each; p elsewhere (L-2 values): qZ = c != 0, a G_m, class L-1 each; total 2(2L-1) + (L-2)(L-1) = L^2 + L
notes.THE MECHANISM, AT CLASS LEVEL: the +L^2 packet is carried by the pair of lines in the degenerate q=0 fibre of Q (times A^1_H); the (p+1)-divisor of the killing arrow meets that fibre exactly along the p = -1 line of the pair. So the surgery is centred on ONE of the two components whose doubling created the packet. The Z-doubling seen at the crossing (RM-3's (qZ^2)) is the same phenomenon read scheme-theoretically.
notes.THE SINGULAR ROUTE IS K_0-NEUTRAL AT EAC: arrows 1 and 2 both have [E] - [D] = 0, matching [X_1 x A^1] = [A^4] = [X x A^1] = L^4. Sol's prediction, certified.
notes.WHERE THE PACKET DIES: E_4 maps onto only the CUSP locus {Z^2+t^3 = 0, q = -HZ} inside the 3-fold D_4, missing the single point (q,t,Z,H) = (0,0,0,0), and is an A^1-bundle over it. So the arrow DELETES the rest of the divisor (class L^3 - L + 1) and replaces the cusp locus (class L^2 - 1) by an A^1-bundle. Net: (L^2-1)(L-1) - (L^3-L+1) = -L^2.
notes.WHERE THE PACKET ENTERS: [Q] = L^2 + L, against L^2 for a plane. The excess +L is the SECOND component of the degenerate q = 0 fibre: Q --> A^1_q has fibre A^1 over q != 0 but splits into the two disjoint lines {p=0} and {p=-1} over q = 0. Times A^1_H that excess is exactly the +L^2 packet. This is the class-level shadow of ADO's (deg P - 1) = 1 wedge summand of P^1 smash P^1.
